body.name: smooth marginal-versus-statewise loss separation
body.construction: For \(\varepsilon_{\mathrm{sep}}>0\), set \(g_{\mathrm{sep}}(x):=\cos(2\pi x_1)\), \(h_{\mathrm{sep}}(y):=\cos(2\pi y_1)\), and \(\eta_{\pm}(y\mid x):=1\pm\varepsilon_{\mathrm{sep}}g_{\mathrm{sep}}(x)h_{\mathrm{sep}}(y)\); define \(Q_{\pm}(dy):=\{\int_{\mathcal X}\eta_{\pm}(y\mid x)\,dx\}dy\).
